title: Running Containers
summary: `docker run` in depth: the container lifecycle, ports, environment, restart policies, resource limits, logs, exec, inspect templates, signals and graceful shutdown of Node.js apps, exit codes, labels and cleanup.
objectives: Describe the container lifecycle states and move a container through them
Run containers with the right flags for ports, environment, restart policy and resource limits
Use logs, exec, cp, stats, events and inspect with Go templates to observe and debug containers
Explain how docker stop and docker kill deliver signals, why PID 1 matters, and implement graceful shutdown in Node.js
Interpret exit codes such as 0, 1, 125, 126, 127, 137 and 143
Label, filter and clean up containers, images, volumes and build cache safely

resources.note: Every flag of docker run, with examples.
